completion_data.completion_summary: Fixed five independently-verified extension-manifest defects: reshaped literature's crashing keyword_overrides to the object-valued form, dropped its unused filetypes dependency (breaking the cslib->lean->literature->filetypes cascade), corrected epidemiology's mcpServers casing so the rmcp server actually merges, deleted a 3MB unreferenced pptx template, activated three orphaned mcp_servers blocks (founder, filetypes, memory) via new settings-fragment.json files routed through merge_targets.settings, deleted present's dead superdoc block, and swept 23 empty mcp_servers/hooks stubs across 17 manifests. check-extension-docs.sh and verify-deploy.sh --findings both remain at zero findings, matching the pre-change baseline.

memory_candidates.content: When jq-rewriting many JSON manifest files to delete a specific stub field (e.g. `del(.hooks)`), piping the whole file through `jq --indent N <filter>` reformats every array in the file to jq's canonical multi-line style, even arrays the filter never touched (e.g. a compact `["a", "b"]` becomes multi-line). This creates unwanted diff churn that fails a 'diff shows only the intended deletion' verification bar. Fix: after any repo-wide jq rewrite pass, immediately `git diff` before committing; if it shows more than the intended lines changed, revert (`git show HEAD:<path> > <path>` is safe when `git checkout -- <path>` is blocked by a destructive-git guard on a dirty tree) and redo with a targeted string-based Edit/sed touching only the specific trailing field, not a full-file jq rewrite.

For a manifest field consumed via `{ '<key>': { 'keywords': [...] } }` shape (e.g. keyword_overrides consumed by task.md's routing jq), a sibling manifest with a bare string-valued shape (`{'<key>': 'value'}`) will crash the consumer jq with 'Cannot index string with string' and exit 5 -- and if the caller redirects stderr to /dev/null, this failure is completely silent, so the feature simply never routes anything and nobody notices. When auditing manifest-driven config across an extension system, always test the consumer's actual jq/parsing invocation directly against each declaring manifest (without stderr suppression) rather than trusting that a present field means a working feature.
